ns2:course.label: Intl Political Economy
ns2:course.description: Comprehensive introduction to major traditions in contemporary thought on the political structure and workings of the global economy. Presumes background knowledge pertaining to the workings of the international economy and its institutions as well as familiarity with the assumptions and approaches of classical I. P. E. thought and International Relations theory. Prerequisite: PS 580.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to PHD:Political Science -UIUC.
